hook: Smoke filled the room. Nobody moved.
facts: In 1968, *Latané and Darley* piped smoke into a waiting room.
Alone, *75%* of people reported it within minutes.
With two calm actors beside them, only *10%* did.
Nobody panicked. They just copied the *calm* people around them.
outro: Smoke filled the room. Would you move?
title: Psychology Facts
